characters.name: Brave Survivor

storyProgress.currentObjective: Find a way to recharge the depleted Awakened Sea Fruit and locate a safe path forward beyond the exit tunnel
storyProgress.currentChallenge: Navigate unknown territory with a nearly powerless fruit while the Slumbering Darkness may still be in pursuit

fruitAwakenings: Sea God's Throne fruit (Depleted - expended final charge creating a seawater shield to escape the Slumbering Darkness)

locations.name: Hidden Bunker
locations.description: A secret underground facility now partially destroyed; laser grids have died, walls are cracked from the Darkness's roar, and floodwater surges through the corridors

locations.name: Flooded Bunker Corridor
locations.description: A corridor fully flooded with churning water, lasers dead, ceiling partially collapsed from the Darkness's assault

locations.name: Exit Tunnel
locations.description: A dimly lit tunnel glimpsed through the chaos, offering a path out of the collapsing bunker into unknown territory
notableFeatures: Last escape route from the bunker

locations.name: Blox Fruits Grid
locations.description: A vast server filled with unknown dangers and opportunities

items.name: Awakened Fruit
items.description: A mysterious and ancient power with unknown abilities

items.name: Awakened Sea Fruit (Depleted)
items.description: A cobalt-infused awakened fruit from the Sea God's Throne, now fully depleted after expending its final charge to create a seawater shield that held back the Slumbering Darkness's shadow tendrils long enough to escape

mainStory.description: Brave Survivor escaped the collapsing Sea God's Throne Chamber by sacrificing the Awakened Sea Fruit's final power to breach the Slumbering Darkness's wall of shadow tendrils. The bunker is destroyed, the lasers are dead, and the fruit is spent. Now they must find safety and a way to restore the fruit's power before the Darkness catches up.
